status: prospective plan recorded before candidate scoring; all October-November evidence is development
target: Positive gross fulfilled units by order date; completed/shipped/returned statuses normalized; exact duplicate rows removed; nonpositive excluded; returns not netted without dated usable receipts
status_information_boundary: Exported final statuses lack change timestamps; historical comparisons conditional on final labels and cannot simulate past known statuses
population: 336 supplied policy keys, all with first fulfilled transaction before development origins; current policy used only to define coverage-length diagnostic, not claimed historically known
missing_dates: Calendar-wide transaction presence verified. Zero recorded units after each pair's first positive fulfilled sale, conditional on file completeness; pre-first-sale days unknown. Fit seasonal model only on complete Monday-Sunday weeks after first sale.
training: Expanding history beginning 2022-01-01 through each origin; all methods receive only dated sales through that origin
evaluation: Following 7 and 14 days and current per-key lead-time-plus-seven-day coverage (8-14 days), all ending by 2025-11-30
reserved: December 2025 sales never accessed or scored

baseline.name: recent84
baseline.definition: Mean recorded units per calendar day over last 84 days, or available post-first-sale exposure if shorter; flat future daily rate
baseline.incumbent: Analytical recent-average baseline, not exact customer method; exact lookback and quantity rule unknown

candidates.name: recent84
candidates.rationale: Fair reproducible interpretation of recent months; small retained daily panel; no supplied exact incumbent

candidates.name: sba
candidates.rationale: Croston SBA with fixed smoothing 0.1 on complete weeks handles intermittent positive sizes and arrival gaps; sparse per-key transactions observed in input-4.csv; no seasonal assumption

candidates.name: poisson
candidates.rationale: Regularized pooled Poisson regression on weekly units with pair intercept, common month effects and global linear trend; shares seasonal evidence across sparse keys and uses 2022-2025 history. Fixed alpha=0.001, max_iter=300; no tuning grid

primary_metric: Mean absolute error of next-seven-day totals, product units per key-origin; equal weight over identical 336 keys and eight origins
selection_rule: Lowest primary MAE; baseline retained when within 1% relative of best (analyst numerical simplicity tie convention, not external meaningful-improvement threshold). Nonbaseline ties within 1% prefer SBA over Poisson. Select once, no further model search.
secondary_diagnostics: include processing and exclude returned/return-flagged target sensitivity only; not model selection
CPU fit/predict runtime, wall time and whole-process peak RSS including preparation and retained arrays
business_limits: No historical stock/stockout exposure or prices; forecast scores establish neither availability, purchasing cost savings nor superiority to unspecified incumbent. Unknown true demand is not zero.
deployment_horizon: Primary selection 7 days; quantities cover 8-14 days. Report diagnostic support and disagreement; no historical inventory policy simulation.
performance_success_gate: Open: lacks externally predeclared meaningful threshold and independent untouched evaluation with frozen artifacts. Development investigation cannot close gate.
